svg.title: Two households, and what P.L. 119-21 reaches in each
svg.desc: Two composite households side by side. A family of four: Parent, 36, Adults, loses 6.8 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care; Parent, 34, Adults, loses 6.8 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care; Child, 15, Children, loses 4.4 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care; Child, 11, Children, loses 4.4 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care A family of five: Parent, 41, Adults, loses 6.8 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care; Parent, 39, Adults, loses 6.8 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care; Child, 9, Children, loses 4.4 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care; Child, 7 · disabled, Disabled, loses 4.7 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care; Grandmother, 74 · dual, Aged, loses 4.8 percent of the Medicaid dollars behind their care

svg.text: WHAT REACHES THEM

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six-month renewals, from January 2027 — twice the chances to fall out

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Enrollment-rule suspensions — harder to get back in once out

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Provider tax limits and the residual — a smaller program around them

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Work reporting from 2029, when the younger child turns 14

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The exemption expires on a birthday.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The younger child turns 14 in 2029 and both parents move to the 80-hour standard

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside the window this paper covers. Their exposure roughly triples, from 6.8% to

svg.text: nursing facility care, and a bill

svg.text: of the Medicaid dollars behind their care

svg.text: WHAT REACHES THEM

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six-month renewals and the enrollment-rule suspensions, as next door

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Directed payment caps — the nursing facility's rate, not their coverage

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Medicare Savings rule suspended — the grandmother's premium

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Work reporting never reaches them: a disabled dependent has no age limit

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The exemption never expires. The bill arrives anyway.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Caring for a disabled dependent carries no age ceiling, so the work rule passes

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over this household for good. What reaches it instead is a transfer: Medicaid

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stops paying the grandmother's Medicare costs and she starts.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The grandmother's bill is not a service anyone stops providing. In 2026 the Medicare Savings Programs pay a $202.90 monthly Part B premium — $2,435 a year — and, under QMB, the

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: $283 Part B deductible and the 20 percent coinsurance on every outpatient service. A hospital stay adds a $1,736 Part A deductible per benefit period.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Composite households, not cases. Rates are modelled: each provision allocated to the population the statute names, then across services by that population's measured FY2024 consumption. See the Limits register.
